assign.outcome:
**Five live cards for a page's box** — `shell` `measure` `inset` `region` `full` at [/framework/core/Page/overview/](/framework/core/Page/overview/), each showing ONE thing, with every number read off the DOM.

![](region.png)

- **[shell](/framework/core/Page/overview/shell/)** — the three tracks as three bordered bands, each wearing its own `offsetWidth`. Wherever the page is narrower than the measure, `main` and `wide` read the same number; press mega and `wide` is several times `main`.
- **[measure](/framework/core/Page/overview/measure/)** — one slider on `--measure` plus a `100%` button, and a derived line naming which arm of the `min()` is binding. Under it a **live CSSOM scan** lists every `--measure` declaration that actually matches this page (`.pages` and `.page`, both 40em) — read, never typed, so the card stays true the day the proposal moves the declaration.
- **[inset](/framework/core/Page/overview/inset/)** — a slider each for `--page-pad`, `--gutter-x`, `--pad-y`, plus a clear button. The readout says whether `--page-pad` is set and therefore whether `--pad-y` is doing anything: the `.doc-section { --pad-y: 1.5em }` bug, live.
- **[region](/framework/core/Page/overview/region/)** — the evidence card. One page in `.pages`, in a real `tabs()` `.tab-panel`, and in a `.demo-app-pages`, each printing what the REGION declares beside what the PAGE got. Two regions ask for `--measure: none` and every page still reports `40em`; `--page-pad` from the same rule arrives every time. At mega the regions are 3440 / 3392 / 3428px and all three main tracks are **602px**.
- **[full](/framework/core/Page/overview/full/)** — five buttons over a nested mock of the site's regions. Which chrome a takeover costs is DERIVED (does the lit box contain the strip), not typed beside the button. It describes and demonstrates; it ships no fullscreen mechanism.

**Verified headless at 1280** — five urls, zero console errors, `.page.active-page` on each. The two that must agree: the `.tab-panel` page's main track reads **479px** from the card and **479px** from a direct `getComputedStyle` in the probe.

**Left deliberately:** the module's own docs (`core/Page/readme.md`, `doc/layout.md`) — outside this task's fences. No CSS file and no new class name was added.

log.msg: PEER BUG WAS MINE, fixed. Cause: my thumbs hand-marked .page.active-page, and a wall thumb lives inside the Doc's subtree - so the Doc matched .active-ancestor:has(.page.active-page) (Page.css:8) and stayed on screen as a peer, halving the region to 545px. Fix, five dirs only: every board takes a `thumb` flag; in a thumb the page wears `default` (ext/demo's convention, app.js:124-141) and the box DROPS the `pages` class with it, because Page.css:42-45 rewrites a `.default` that is a direct child of .pages into the region's empty state (display: block + its own padding) and would flatten the grid. shell's board also lost its duplicate title, which was stamping a second page--shell.

verified: /framework/core/Page/ has 22 thumbs and ZERO .page-preview-thumb .page.active-page. All five leaves are now direct children of the framework .pages at 1051px (was 545), the Doc view is absent on a leaf route, zero console errors. region's readouts at rest: regions 965 / 927 / 963px and all three main tracks 602px - the finding now lands at the default width, no device strip needed. Card 602px vs probe getComputedStyle 602px: agree. region.png and shell.png re-shot.

assign.outcome:
**Follow-up landed — the peer-region bug was mine, and it is fixed.**

A wall thumb renders inside the Doc's own subtree, so the `.page.active-page` my cards hand-marked made the Doc match `.active-ancestor:has(.page.active-page)` (Page.css:8) and stay on screen beside the routed leaf — both pages then split the region and every card got 545px instead of 1051px.

![](shell.png)

- Every board now takes a `thumb` flag. In a thumb the page wears **`default`** — ext/demo's convention (app.js:124-141), the contract's own word for shown-without-being-routed-to — and the box **drops the `pages` class with it**, because Page.css:42-45 rewrites a `.default` that is a direct child of `.pages` into the region's empty state (`display: block` plus its own padding) and would flatten the very grid these cards are about.
- `shell`'s board also lost its duplicate `title`, which was stamping a second `page--shell` on the document.
- `full` needed no change: its board contains no `.page` at all.

**Verified headless at 1280.** On [/framework/core/Page/](/framework/core/Page/): 22 thumbs, **0** `.page-preview-thumb .page.active-page`. On all five leaves: the routed page is a direct child of the framework `.pages` at **1051px**, the Doc view is absent, zero console errors.

**The region card is stronger for it** — at the restored width the regions read 965 / 927 / 963px and **all three main tracks read 602px at rest**, so the finding no longer needs the device strip. Card 602px vs a direct `getComputedStyle` in the probe 602px: agree.
